title: How the Father Sent the Three Strongholds Downward So the Mingled Elements Could Be Drawn Out
arc: The Father of Life pours the three strongholds — of Water, Darkness, and Fire — down from heaven onto the earth in stages so that the same three elements still trapped inside the natural can be drawn upward to meet their kindred and so be separated forth, leaving the residue cast outside the cosmos and the cleansed firmaments standing as the road of the Illuminators.
reading:
This chapter answers a single cosmological question: why did the Father of Life not send the three strongholds straight from heaven to the fossae prepared to receive them, but instead first hurl them down onto the earth and only afterwards lift them back up to their high stations? The answer is that the strongholds are not merely the receiving-pits of corruption; they are also the divine instruments by which the corruption already lodged inside the earth is drawn out. The whole teaching is a description of this two-stage redemptive operation, applied to each of the three lower elements in turn.

The starting picture is the Father of Greatness pouring forth three Mighty Ones — three confirmed binding-states in ultimates, one belonging to the Mother (Water), one to Darkness, and one to Fire. These are not eaten into the firmament along a single side; they are eaten down into the first earth, which is to say accommodated all the way to the lowest natural. Each Mighty One descends to its own appointed place at its appointed time. They are then drawn out again and clothed — the garment of Wind, the garment of the Mother (Water), and the garment of Fire — and set as outward forms over the body of the cosmos along the three roads established at the founding of the world, so that nothing of those three elements is left lying loose. They are cast upon the faces of the earth out of the three strongholds so that one may discern their likeness and their type when they become manifest forth from the cosmos.

The teacher then names the present visible signs of this work. The element prepared in the water is the burning brine: the salty sea that surrounds the cosmos. The element prepared as Darkness is the mountain of darkness that stands "in the side of radiance" until the end — the dark mass which, even when the sun shines in the cosmos, no lamp of light can penetrate, because the darkness gushing out of it covers the heaven from itself. The element left set in the fire on the earth is the mountains, with their springs, where the channels of fire gush upward and reveal themselves; in these places no tree grows, because they are the visible preparation of the great stronghold — fire mingled with the fire that comes up out of the earth, gathered into the mountains and slopes. So the strongholds are at once the heavenly forms set above and the recognizable scars in nature: salt sea, dark mountain, fire-mountain. They are the appearances by which the inner state of the cosmos can be read.

With this picture in place, the teaching turns to the central question: why was the cosmos surrounded by these strongholds in this roundabout way? The answer is the doctrine of correspondence-by-kinship. The water, darkness, and fire that exist in the three earths — that is, the elements of mingling already lodged in the natural mind — could only be lifted out by being drawn toward their own kindred. So the Father first sent the strongholds down to the earth, and only afterwards raised them up and cast them up to the height. He did this so that the water and the darkness and the fire below should draw upward against the water, darkness, and fire that had come down from above. The descended element acts as a magnet for the buried element; its kindred above pulls its kindred below up out of its hiding, and what is mingled is thereby loosened.

The chapter then walks through the three operations in order. First the Water of Error is poured forth from heaven into the midst of the archons that are above; the firmaments are purified, the waters of darkness are sent down, the waters fall from heaven to earth, and the waters below in the earths are drawn upward to meet the waters that came forth from heaven. The Darkness in those waters is purified out and driven to the outside, cast into a great place of deceit and a shore of the sea — that very salt-shore which surrounds the cosmos in which the ships sail. So the salty sea is itself the deposit-state of the darkness extracted from the natural waters by this meeting. Then the Darkness is poured out: the firmaments are purified, the darkness gathered there is rolled forth and cast down to the earth, and the darkness in the lands is drawn upward to meet the darkness from heaven; the two are driven forth together and gathered into the stronghold-state set apart for them. Then the fire is poured out from heaven to earth; at that very hour the fire gathered within the lower earth is drawn up to meet its kindred, fire is added upon fire, and the whole is driven forth into the West outside the cosmos — the place established for it beyond the boundary.

Each pass repeats the same logic: pouring from above, the buried element drawn upward to its kindred, the two driven out together to a fixed place outside or above. This is the doctrine of separation forth as cosmic surgery: like is drawn by like, and what was hidden in mingling is forced into manifestation by being met with its own form sent down for that purpose. The same operation by which the firmaments above were purified to be the road of going for the Illuminators (sun and moon as the two ships of light) is the operation by which the lands below are purified — driving forth from them the fire and the darkness and the water, so that the three powers, of Wind, of Water, and of Fire, may rise up through the midst, out of the Omophoros that bears the lands.

The whole teaching, then, describes how the Lord's restraining and refining wisdom does not extract evil by sheer fiat from above, but by setting in the natural a corresponding outward form — sea, dark mountain, burning mountain — whose kinship to the buried evil draws that evil into the open where it can be separated and bound. The three strongholds surrounding the cosmos are the standing proof of a finished extraction; the Illuminators travel a heaven that has already been cleansed by exactly this method; and the elements still rising through the Omophoros at the bottom are the same operation continuing in the lower earths until the consummation. The meaning for the soul is parallel and unmistakable: the falsities of the natural mind are not lifted out abstractly but by encountering their own likeness in revealed form, and that meeting — kindred drawn to kindred — is what permits the Lord to drive them out of the regenerating life into the place fixed for them outside.
